summary: Profile tab updates: enhance Match History to show wins/losses by date for the last 5 availabilities in a single chronological list, and remove the 'Additional Information' section above leaderboard rankings.

existing_features.title: Update the Profile tab UI to remove the entire "Additional Information" card/section (the section above leaderboard rankings), and instead render distinct sections for "Leaderboard Rankings" and "Match History" on the profile page.

Implement a Match History list on the Profile tab that shows a single combined chronological list of the caller's last 5 availabilities played, where each list item displays the date and the wins and losses recorded for that date.

Update React Query hooks and consuming pages to use the new backend query API(s) for fetching the caller’s available days (and per-day win/loss data) without requiring admin permissions, and integrate these hooks into the Profile page Match History UI.

new_feature_requests.summary: Update Profile > Match History to display wins/losses broken down by date for the last 5 availabilities played, shown together in a single chronological list.
Remove the 'Additional Information' section from the Profile tab (the section above leaderboard rankings).

Add backend query API(s) to support Profile > Match History by returning the caller’s available day IDs and the caller’s per-day win/loss totals (DailyLog) for those days, with user-only authorization enforced consistently with existing stats/availability endpoints.

projectName: Profile: remove Additional Information section and add Match History wins/losses by date (last 5 availabilities)
